## Lizardfolk Scaled Soldier (CR 4)

**XP** 1,200  
 Male lizardfolk fighter 4  
 CN Medium humanoid (reptilian)  
 **Init** +2; **Senses** Perception +4  

**Defense**

 **AC** 21, touch 13, flat-footed 18 (+1 dodge, +6 armor, +2 Dex, +1 natural)  
 **hp** 47 (6 HD; 2d8+4d10+16)  
 **Fort** +9, **Ref** +3, **Will** +1 (+1 vs. fear)  
 **Defensive Abilities** bravery +1  

**Offense**

 **Speed** 30 ft., swim 15 ft.  
 **Melee** +1 axe musket +11 (1d8+9/x3), bite +7 (1d4+2), tail swipe +7 (1d4+2) or 2 claws +9 (1d4+4), bite +9 (1d4+4), tail swipe +7 (1d4+2)  
 **Ranged** +1 axe musket +9 (1d8+3/x4)  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 18, **Dex** 14, Con 15, **Int** 11, **Wis** 10, Cha 8  
 **Base Atk** +5; **CMB** +9; **CMD** 22  
 **Feats** Dangerous Tail, Multiattack, [Point-Blank Shot](../../rules/feats/point-blank-shot.md), Weapon Focus (axe musket), Weapon Focus (axe musket), [Dodgility](../../rules/feats/dodge.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Dodgility.*  
 **Skills** Acrobatics +7, Intimidate +4, Perception +4, Swim +14; **Racial Modifiers** +4 Acrobatics  
 **Languages** Common, Draconic  
 **SQ** armor training 1, hold breath  
 **Other Gear** masterwork trooper armor, +1 axe musket with 20 bullets, powder horn, 20 gp
